WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     spend_agg AS
  (SELECT s.spend_date AS DAY,

   INNER JOIN search_campaigns c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-07'
   GROUP BY DAY),

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` l
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-07'
   GROUP BY DAY),
     combined_daily AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(s.day, l.day) AS DAY,
          COALESCE(s.spend_eur, 0) AS ad_spend_eur,
          COALESCE(l.leads_count, 0) AS leads
   FROM spend_agg s
   FULL OUTER JOIN leads_agg l ON s.day = l.day)
SELECT 'Overall (Early Oct 2026)' AS period,
       SUM(ad_spend_eur) AS total_ad_spend_eur,
       SUM(leads) AS total_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(ad_spend_eur), SUM(leads)), 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur

       ad_spend_eur AS total_ad_spend_eur,
       leads AS total_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(ad_spend_eur, leads), 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur

WITH sma_10010_cte AS
  (SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(created_date, DAY) AS metric_time__day ,

          1 AS __leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`leads` leads_src_10000
   WHERE created_date IN ('2026-10-01',
                          '2026-10-02') )
SELECT CAST(SUM(__bookings) AS FLOAT64) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__leads), 0) AS FLOAT64) AS overall_lead_to_booking_rate ,
       ROUND(CAST(SUM(__bookings) AS FLOAT64) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__leads), 0) AS FLOAT64) * 100, 2) AS overall_lead_to_booking_percentage ,
       SUM(__leads) AS total_leads ,
       SUM(__bookings) AS total_booked_leads
FROM
  (SELECT subq_4.lead ,
          subq_4.__leads ,
          COALESCE(subq_15.__bookings, 0) AS __bookings
   FROM

             1 AS __leads

      GROUP BY lead) subq_4
   LEFT JOIN

             1 AS __bookings
      FROM sma_10010_cte
      INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`bookings` bookings_src_10000 ON sma_10010_cte.lead = bookings_src_10000.lead_id
      AND TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(bookings_src_10000.booked_date, DAY) >= sma_10010_cte.metric_time__day
      AND TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(bookings_src_10000.booked_date, DAY) <= DATE_ADD(CAST(sma_10010_cte.metric_time__day AS DATETIME), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

args.sql:
SELECT CASE
           WHEN c.signup_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 'Before 2026'
           ELSE 'In 2026'
       END AS signup_cohort,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS non_cancelled_orders,
       SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue_eur,
       AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount_eur
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o

       OR (c.signup_date >= '2026-01-01'
           AND c.signup_date < '2027-01-01'))
GROUP BY signup_cohort

WITH cohort_stats AS
  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN c.signup_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 'before_2026'
              ELSE 'in_2026'

          SUM(o.amount) / COUNT(o.order_id) AS avg_amount

     AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
   GROUP BY cohort)

           END) AS avg_amount_in_2026,
